name: 11249 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11249 (Brooklyn) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11249 (Brooklyn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
